title: Key Astros reliever Steven Okert placed on injured list amid team’s postseason push
content:
HOUSTON — In a substantial blow to their well-performing bullpen, the Houston Astros placed southpaw Steven Okert on the 15-day injured list Friday with a right hamstring strain. The IL stint is retroactive to Sept. 1.

Okert is amid a resurgent season that’s seen him occupy various roles in Houston’s bullpen — from set-up man to fireman to opener. Most recently, Okert has settled into a seventh-inning role behind set-up man Bryan Abreu and closer Josh Hader. According to both Baseball-Reference and FanGraphs, Okert has been Houston’s second-most valuable reliever this season, trailing only Hader, who just earned American League Reliever of the Month honors in August.

The 35-year-old Okert owns a 2.13 ERA and 0.87 WHIP across 68 appearances. No Astros reliever has made more, and only three in all of MLB have logged more outings than Okert.

The Astros enter their weekend series against the Arizona Diamondbacks with a two-game lead over the Texas Rangers in the American League West.

This story will be updated.
